_note: Retrieval aliases for upstream skills whose metadata is English-only.
Upstream OpenScience ships English descriptions and often no tags at all, so a
Chinese query cannot reach them: '科研绘图' never matches a skill whose only words
are 'publication-ready figures'. rebuild.py merges these extra trigger words into
registry.json at build time, which keeps the fix durable across rebuilds without
hand-editing files that the next copy would overwrite. Keys are exact skill names;
values are tags appended to the existing ones (duplicates are ignored).
Prefer terms a user would actually type. Keep them specific enough not to collide
